story.zh: 曹操百万大军兵临江东，于赤壁港口搭建水寨并日夜操练，刘备听从谋士的建议与孙权联手抗曹...
story.en: Cao Cao's army of one million bore down on Jiangdong, constructing a naval fortress at the port of Chibi and drilling day and night. Heeding the counsel of his strategists, Liu Bei allied with Sun Quan to resist Cao Cao...

trigger.zh: 曹操、刘关张、赵云，诸葛亮、孙权、周瑜存活。襄阳、新野属曹操，江夏属刘备，柴桑、建业属孙权。
trigger.en: Cao Cao, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang, Sun Quan, and Zhou Yu are alive. Xiangyang and Xinye belong to Cao Cao, Jiangxia belongs to Liu Bei, and Chaisang and Jianye belong to Sun Quan.

forbidden.zh: 主角是庞统时无法触发。
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Pang Tong.

people.zh: 刘备势力至少需要2名额外文武官，孙权势力至少需要3名额外文官，曹操势力至少需要6名额外武官
people.en: Liu Bei's Faction requires at least 2 additional Scholars or Warriors, Sun Quan's Faction requires at least 3 additional Scholars, Cao Cao's Faction requires at least 6 additional Warriors

defy.en: 【<Cao Cao's Faction> Occupy Jiangxia and Chaisang】
